description:
BTF-LIGHTING 960LEDs/m COB RGBCCT LED Strip Light 6Pin 12mm Flexible High Density Dimmable RA90 24V

Welcome to BTF-LIGHTING
✅【All goods are in stock】
【You can receive the package within 5 to 10 days】
【Checked before shipment and properly packed to avoid damage during shipping】
【 Free replacement of new products within 1 year（if have bad quality problems）】

Specification:
Input Voltage: DC24V.
Wattage: 18W/M.
FPCB width: 12mm.
FPCB height: 1.6mm.
LED quantity: 960LEDs/M.
Cutting length: every 41.5mm.
Colors: RGB+WW+CW, Any Colors Changeable.
Color Rendering Index: Ra＞90.
Operation temperature: -20℃-+45℃.
Storage temperature: -20℃-+60℃.
View angle: 180°.
Applicable controllers: SP530E, SP630E, WB5, LM052, LM053, SP535E, SP635E, CO5W, C05Z.(You can find the controller in this store.)

Package Included:
1m / 2m: 1pcs FCOB RGBCCT LED strip. (without power supply and controller)
3m/4m/5m: 1pcs FCOB RGBCCT LED strip + 2pcs 6PIN-12MM board-to-wire connectors + 1pcs 6PIN-24AWG-15CM cable + 3pcs 12MM clips + 3pcs screws. (power supply and controller not included)

Features:
Using mini 0402 LED as light source, and glue on surface to make the lights more evenly and uniform.
Up to 960 LEDs each meter, Double layer FPCB, balancing the voltage dropping, heat dissipation and flexibility.
Compatible with most of the 6pin RGBCCT controllers in the markets.
Applications, Residential lighting, decorative lighting.
This LED lights need work with 6pin RGBCCT controller.
